title: The Souvenir Chatspace
overview: Your home base for working with AI — start a chat, switch models on the fly, and keep every conversation in one place.

steps.text: To begin, click the Chats tab to access your conversation history and messaging interface.
Click here to switch your AI model — pick the one that fits your task.
Select Muse for everyday tasks. It's fast, smart, and uses fewer credits.
Next, click the dropdown menu to select a different AI Muse model.
Select Advanced for complex or high-stakes tasks — best quality, no compromises.
Then, enter your question or request in the message input field to chat.
Finally, click the send button to submit your message to the agent.
